name: Lever Style Corporation
summary: Lever Style Corporation, founded in 1956 and based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company, owned by LFX Growth Capital Limited, that designs apparel and provides supply chain solutions to customers in the United States, Europe, Oceania, Canada and Greater China. Its product categories include denim, knitwear, leather, outerwear, shirts, suits, sweaters and intimates.
